name: @dcp/bungee-pro-failure-case
description: DELIBERATE FAILURE CASE: three Button instances modeled as three separate components. This is what an automated style-signature clustering pipeline would produce if it could not make the judgment call that bungee-pro's .button-primary, .button-primary-v2, and three contextual usages are variants of one Button rather than three distinct components. The point is not that this framing is wrong — the point is that the judgment is required, and style-signature equivalence alone cannot make it.
